task.summary: Compare next16 consecutive original cases using existing products and unchanged assertions

selectionReason: Reuse original catalog and existing observation workflow. All16 consecutive originals1073..1087 remain in scope. Managed outcomes close first; reviewed295 sources are compared before Native. Closed assertion failures remain failures; only both-passing original pairs can gain credit. Same180s case and3072s cohort budgets; no compiler, source, oracle or policy changes.

args: import json,hashlib,sys;from pathlib import Path;a=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes());h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper();assert len(a['selectedCatalog'])==a['selected']==16 and a['originalTotal']==2708;assert h(a['selectionAuthority'])==a['selectionAuthoritySha256'];authority=json.loads(Path(a['selectionAuthority']).read_bytes());assert set(a['selectedCatalog'])<=set(authority['selectedCatalog']);assert a['originalFilesVerified']==38 and all(h(x['path'])==x['sha256']==h(x['originalPath']) for x in a['originalFiles']);print('ORIGINAL16_INPUTS_AND_SCOPE_ADMITTED')
actions.label: Verify original16 inputs and authority before cost

args: import json,subprocess,sys;from pathlib import Path;args=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(args[args.index('--output')+1]);assert not out.exists();p=subprocess.run(args,check=False);assert p.returncode in [0,1];d=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_bytes());assert d['attempted']==d['total']==16 and d['inputsStable'] and d['processesStopped'];assert len(d['cases'])==16 and all(x['status'] in ['passed','failed'] for x in d['cases']);assert (p.returncode==0)==(d['status']=='passed' and not d['failedCases']);assert (p.returncode==1)==(d['status']=='failed' and bool(d['failedCases']));print('MANAGED16_ORIGINAL_ASSERTIONS_OBSERVED_PASSES_NOT_INFERRED')
actions.label: Observe all16 original m cases once; retain assertion failures

args: import json,hashlib,sys;from pathlib import Path;m=Path(sys.argv[1]);d=json.loads(m.read_bytes());a=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes());h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper();assert d['status'] in ['passed','failed'] and d['attempted']==d['total']==16 and d['completed']+len(d['failedCases'])==16 and d['inputsStable'] and d['processesStopped'];assert d['selectedCatalog']==a['selectedCatalog'];assert all(h(x['path'])==x['sha256']==h(x['originalPath']) for x in a['originalFiles']);rv=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_bytes());assert len(rv['sourceHashes'])==295 and all(h(p)==v for p,v in rv['sourceHashes'].items());p=Path(sys.argv[4]);assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes((json.dumps(dict(status='source-compared-after-closed-managed-observations',managedAttempted=16,managedPassed=d['completed'],managedFailed=d['failedCases'],managedResult=dict(path=str(m),sha256=h(m)),selectedCatalog=a['selectedCatalog'],sourceHashes=rv['sourceHashes'],regressionCredit=0,purpose='Pair all original observations with unchanged Native product; no implementation promotion or changed oracle'),indent=2)+chr(10)).encode());print('MANAGED16_CLOSED_OUTCOMES_CAPTURED_SOURCE295_COMPARED_BEFORE_NATIVE16')

args: import json,sys;from pathlib import Path;m=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes());n=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes());assert m['attempted']==n['attempted']==m['total']==n['total']==16 and n['inputsStable'] and n['processesStopped'];assert m['selectedCatalog']==n['selectedCatalog'];rows=[dict(id=a['id'],managed=a['status'],native=b['status']) for a,b in zip(m['cases'],n['cases'])];assert all(x['id']==y['id'] for x,y in zip(m['cases'],n['cases']));passed=[x['id'] for x in rows if x['managed']==x['native']=='passed'];p=Path(sys.argv[3]);assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes((json.dumps(dict(status='paired-observations-complete-check-individual-assertions',originalCases=16,managedPassed=m['completed'],nativePassed=n['completed'],bothPassed=passed,unresolved=[x for x in rows if x['managed']!='passed' or x['native']!='passed'],originalSourceAndOracleEdits=False,records=[sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]],claimsGoalComplete=False),indent=2)+chr(10)).encode());print(json.dumps(dict(bothPassed=len(passed),unresolved=16-len(passed))))
